faq.section.title: FAQ
faq.privacy.a: Files are processed entirely in your browser. Nothing is ever sent to any server.
faq.howto.step1: Export the logs you want to merge (FIT format recommended if available)
faq.howto.step2: Delete the original logs from Garmin Connect or Strava (the merged file cannot be uploaded while duplicates exist)
faq.howto.step3: Drop the log files onto this page (or click to select)
faq.howto.step4: Timestamps are automatically analyzed, files are merged, and the download begins
faq.howto.step5: Import the downloaded merged_activity file into Garmin Connect or Strava (if Strava auto-sync is enabled, upload to the sync source and Strava will update automatically — if not, import manually into Strava)
faq.tip.a: FIT files contain rich data including power meter readings, temperature, and pedaling dynamics. If FIT data is available, use it for merging — GPX loses much of this detail. FIT is also the recommended format when manually uploading to Strava.
